CREATE TRIGGER native_agent_counters_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON native_agent_counters
WHEN NEW.agent_id IS NOT OLD.agent_id OR NEW.session_generation < OLD.session_generation
  OR NEW.completion_sequence < OLD.completion_sequence OR NEW.input_sequence < OLD.input_sequence
  OR NEW.work_sequence < OLD.work_sequence OR NEW.user_sequence < OLD.user_sequence
  OR NEW.revision < OLD.revision
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Native chat counters only move forward');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_agent_counters_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_agent_counters
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Native chat counters are never deleted');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_sessions_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON native_sessions
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.agent_id IS NOT OLD.agent_id OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider
  OR NEW.conversation_id IS NOT OLD.conversation_id OR NEW.generation IS NOT OLD.generation
  OR NEW.transport IS NOT OLD.transport OR NEW.process_pid IS NOT OLD.process_pid
  OR NEW.process_started IS NOT OLD.process_started OR NEW.owner IS NOT OLD.owner
  OR (OLD.transcript_path IS NOT NULL AND NEW.transcript_path IS NOT OLD.transcript_path) OR NEW.observed_at IS NOT OLD.observed_at
  OR (OLD.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.ended_at IS NOT OLD.ended_at OR NEW.end_reason IS NOT OLD.end_reason))
  OR (OLD.final_captured_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.final_captured_at IS NOT OLD.final_captured_at)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A native session binding keeps its identity and its end');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_sessions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_sessions
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Native session bindings are never deleted');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_captures_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON native_captures
WHEN NEW.agent_id IS NOT OLD.agent_id OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.conversation_id IS NOT OLD.conversation_id
  OR NEW.transcript_path IS NOT OLD.transcript_path OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR NEW.receipt_sequence < OLD.receipt_sequence OR NEW.captured_length < OLD.captured_length
  OR NEW.indexed_offset < OLD.indexed_offset OR (OLD.finalized = 1 AND NEW.finalized = 0)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A native capture cursor only moves forward');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_captures_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_captures
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Native capture cursors are never deleted');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_inputs_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON native_inputs
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.agent_id IS NOT OLD.agent_id OR NEW.session_id IS NOT OLD.session_id
  OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin OR NEW.input_type IS NOT OLD.input_type OR NEW.source_key IS NOT OLD.source_key
  OR NEW.attempt IS NOT OLD.attempt OR NEW.request_hash IS NOT OLD.request_hash OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id
  OR NEW.sensitive IS NOT OLD.sensitive OR NEW.steer IS NOT OLD.steer OR NEW.marker IS NOT OLD.marker OR NEW.sequence IS NOT OLD.sequence
  OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR (OLD.state IN ('submitted','uncertain','failed','undelivered') AND NEW.state IS NOT OLD.state)
  OR (OLD.state = 'waiting' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('waiting','submitting','failed','undelivered'))
  OR (OLD.state = 'submitting' AND NEW.state = 'undelivered')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A native input keeps its identity and never leaves a final state');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_inputs_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_inputs
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Native inputs are never deleted');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_input_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON native_input_events
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'The native input ledger is append-only');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_input_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_input_events
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'The native input ledger is append-only');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_replies_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON native_replies
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A reply completion is never changed');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_replies_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_replies
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A reply completion is never deleted');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_reads_boundary_insert BEFORE INSERT ON native_reads
WHEN NEW.last_read_sequence > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM native_replies WHERE agent_id = NEW.agent_id AND completion_sequence = NEW.last_read_sequence)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A read boundary must be an existing completion');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_reads_boundary_update BEFORE UPDATE ON native_reads
WHEN NEW.agent_id IS NOT OLD.agent_id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id
  OR NEW.last_read_sequence < OLD.last_read_sequence
  OR (NEW.last_read_sequence > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM native_replies WHERE agent_id = NEW.agent_id AND completion_sequence = NEW.last_read_sequence))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A read boundary only moves forward to an existing completion');
END

CREATE TRIGGER native_reads_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_reads
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Read boundaries are never deleted');
END

CREATE TABLE inbox_nudge_needs (
    agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent_profiles(agent_id),
    cycle INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cycle >= 0),
    active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
    opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    opened_at_first TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    next_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(next_sequence >= 1),
    reason TEXT CHECK(reason IS NULL OR length(reason) <= 200),
    -- Where the next bounded scan of this agent's pending deliveries resumes (an event id; 0 = from the start). A hint only:
    -- it is neither an acknowledgement nor an authorization, and every event is authorized again whenever it is read.
    scan_after INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(scan_after >= 0),
    -- Cycle 0 is the row of an agent whose scan has not yet found an authorized event; the first activation is cycle one.
    CHECK(cycle >= 1 OR active = 0)

CREATE TABLE telegram_file_payloads (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(id) = 32 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    installation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(installation_id) = 36),
    principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    operation_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation_name = 'telegram_send_file'),
    request_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    arguments_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(arguments_hash) = 64 AND arguments_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    source_binding_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(source_binding_json) AND json_type(source_binding_json) = 'object'
        AND length(source_binding_json) <= 8192),
    expected_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(expected_sha256) = 64 AND expected_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    filename TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(filename AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
    send_as TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(send_as IN ('document','photo')),
    storage_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(storage_name) = 32 AND storage_name NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    max_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 50000000
        AND (send_as = 'document' OR max_bytes <= 10000000)),
    reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 50000000),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staging' CHECK(state IN ('staging','ready','attached','deleting','deleted')),
    size_bytes INTEGER CHECK(size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 50000000),
    sha256 TEXT CHECK(sha256 IS NULL OR (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND sha256 = expected_sha256)),
    metadata_json TEXT CHECK(metadata_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(metadata_json) AND json_type(metadata_json) = 'object'
        AND length(metadata_json) <= 4096)),
    sealed_at TEXT,
    lease_owner TEXT CHECK(lease_owner IS NULL OR (length(lease_owner) = 32 AND lease_owner NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
    lease_expires_at TEXT,
    expires_at TEXT,
    message_id TEXT REFERENCES telegram_messages(id),
    outbox_id TEXT REFERENCES telegram_outbox(id),
    attached_at TEXT,
    failure_code TEXT CHECK(failure_code IS NULL OR length(failure_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    failure_message TEXT CHECK(failure_message IS NULL OR length(failure_message) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    cleanup_reason TEXT CHECK(cleanup_reason IS NULL OR cleanup_reason IN ('failed','expired','delivered')),
    cleanup_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cleanup_attempts >= 0),
    next_cleanup_at TEXT,
    error_code TEXT CHECK(error_code IS NULL OR length(error_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    error_message TEXT CHECK(error_message IS NULL OR length(error_message) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    error_at TEXT,
    deleted_at TEXT,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(installation_id, principal_id, operation_name, request_key),
    CHECK(size_bytes IS NULL OR size_bytes <= max_bytes),
    CHECK((size_bytes IS NULL) = (sha256 IS NULL) AND (sha256 IS NULL) = (sealed_at IS NULL)
        AND (sealed_at IS NULL) = (metadata_json IS NULL)),
    CHECK(state != 'staging' OR (sealed_at IS NULL AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL
        AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND reserved_bytes = max_bytes AND message_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK(state = 'staging' OR (lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK(state NOT IN ('ready','attached') OR (sealed_at IS NOT NULL AND reserved_bytes IS size_bytes)),
    CHECK(state != 'ready' OR (expires_at IS NOT NULL AND message_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK(state != 'attached' OR message_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK((message_id IS NULL) = (outbox_id IS NULL) AND (outbox_id IS NULL) = (attached_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK((failure_code IS NULL) = (failure_message IS NULL)),
    CHECK(failure_code IS NULL OR (sealed_at IS NULL AND message_id IS NULL AND cleanup_reason IS 'failed')),
    CHECK((error_code IS NULL) = (error_message IS NULL) AND (error_message IS NULL) = (error_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK(state NOT IN ('deleting','deleted') OR cleanup_reason IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK(state != 'deleted' OR (reserved_bytes = 0 AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(state = 'deleted' OR deleted_at IS NULL)
) STRICT
CREATE INDEX telegram_file_payloads_state ON telegram_file_payloads(state, expires_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX telegram_file_payloads_message ON telegram_file_payloads(message_id) WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX telegram_file_payloads_outbox ON telegram_file_payloads(outbox_id) WHERE outbox_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.installation_id IS NOT OLD.installation_id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id
  OR NEW.operation_name IS NOT OLD.operation_name OR NEW.request_key IS NOT OLD.request_key
  OR NEW.arguments_hash IS NOT OLD.arguments_hash OR NEW.source_binding_json IS NOT OLD.source_binding_json
  OR NEW.expected_sha256 IS NOT OLD.expected_sha256 OR NEW.filename IS NOT OLD.filename OR NEW.send_as IS NOT OLD.send_as
  OR NEW.storage_name IS NOT OLD.storage_name OR NEW.max_bytes IS NOT OLD.max_bytes OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR (OLD.sealed_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.size_bytes IS NOT OLD.size_bytes OR NEW.sha256 IS NOT OLD.sha256
      OR NEW.metadata_json IS NOT OLD.metadata_json OR NEW.sealed_at IS NOT OLD.sealed_at))
  OR (OLD.message_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.message_id IS NOT OLD.message_id OR NEW.outbox_id IS NOT OLD.outbox_id
      OR NEW.attached_at IS NOT OLD.attached_at))
  OR (OLD.failure_code IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.failure_code IS NOT OLD.failure_code OR NEW.failure_message IS NOT OLD.failure_message))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Telegram file payload keeps its request, manifest, sealed content and delivery association');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_revision BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN NEW.revision IS NOT OLD.revision + 1
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Telegram file payload changes by compare-and-swap: each update raises the revision by one');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_state BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN NEW.state != OLD.state AND NOT (
       (OLD.state = 'staging' AND NEW.state IN ('ready','deleting'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'ready' AND NEW.state IN ('attached','deleting'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'attached' AND NEW.state = 'deleting')
    OR (OLD.state = 'deleting' AND NEW.state = 'deleted'))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Invalid Telegram file payload state transition');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_insert BEFORE INSERT ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN NEW.state IS NOT 'staging'
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Telegram file payload starts in staging');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_associate BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN OLD.message_id IS NULL AND (NEW.message_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.outbox_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.attached_at IS NOT NULL)
  AND NOT (OLD.state = 'ready' AND NEW.state = 'attached')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Telegram file payload is associated with its delivery only when a ready payload attaches');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_attach BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN OLD.state = 'ready' AND NEW.state = 'attached' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM telegram_outbox o JOIN telegram_messages m ON m.id = o.message_id
    WHERE o.id = NEW.outbox_id AND m.id = NEW.message_id
      AND o.source_kind = 'agent_file' AND o.kind = NEW.send_as AND o.agent_id = NEW.principal_id AND o.state = 'queued'
      AND m.direction = 'outbound' AND m.agent_id = NEW.principal_id AND (m.outbox_id IS NULL OR m.outbox_id = NEW.outbox_id)
      AND CASE WHEN json_valid(o.payload_json) AND json_type(o.payload_json) = 'object' THEN
              (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(o.payload_json)) = 2
              AND json_type(o.payload_json, '$.version') IS 'integer' AND json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.version') IS 1
              AND json_type(o.payload_json, '$.payload_id') IS 'text' AND json_extract(o.payload_json, '$.payload_id') IS NEW.id
          ELSE 0 END)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Telegram file payload attaches only to the queued agent file send of its own message');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_open_delivery BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON telegram_file_payloads
WHEN OLD.state = 'attached' AND NEW.state = 'deleting'
  AND (SELECT state FROM telegram_outbox WHERE id = OLD.outbox_id) NOT IN ('sent','failed','cancelled')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A queued, dispatching or uncertain Telegram delivery keeps its file payload');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_file_payloads_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON telegram_file_payloads
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Telegram file payload receipts are retained');
END

CREATE TRIGGER tasks_parent_insert BEFORE INSERT ON tasks
WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks p WHERE p.business_id IS NEW.business_id AND p.id=NEW.parent_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A parent Task belongs to the same owning scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER tasks_parent_update BEFORE UPDATE OF parent_id ON tasks
WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks p WHERE p.business_id IS NEW.business_id AND p.id=NEW.parent_id)
    OR EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE up(id) AS (
        SELECT NEW.parent_id
        UNION
        SELECT t.parent_id FROM tasks t JOIN up ON t.id=up.id AND t.business_id IS NEW.business_id WHERE t.parent_id IS NOT NULL)
      SELECT 1 FROM up WHERE id=NEW.id))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A Task parent chain cannot contain a cycle or leave its owning scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER tasks_scope_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF id,business_id,created_by,created_at ON tasks
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.business_id IS NOT OLD.business_id OR NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by
  OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A Task keeps its identity, owning scope and creator'); END

CREATE TRIGGER tasks_keep_discussion BEFORE DELETE ON tasks
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM thread_messages WHERE business_id IS OLD.business_id AND item_type='task' AND item_id=OLD.id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A Task with a discussion is retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER thread_messages_task_scope BEFORE INSERT ON thread_messages
WHEN NEW.item_type='task' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE business_id IS NEW.business_id AND id=NEW.item_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A Task discussion belongs to a Task in the same owning scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER thread_follows_task_scope BEFORE INSERT ON thread_follows
WHEN NEW.item_type='task' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE business_id IS NEW.business_id AND id=NEW.item_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A Task follow belongs to a Task in the same owning scope'); END

CREATE TABLE action_logs (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    category TEXT CHECK (category IS NULL OR category IN ('global-systems','global-operational','business-operational')),
    action_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(action_text)) > 0),
    performed_by TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
    recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('manual','agent','automatic','legacy')),
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    occurred_date TEXT,
    occurred_hour INTEGER CHECK (occurred_hour IS NULL OR occurred_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23),
    time_precision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'instant' CHECK (time_precision IN ('instant','hour','day')),
    time_zone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'America/Puerto_Rico',
    refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(refs_json)),
    related_objects_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(related_objects_json)),
    withdrawn INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (withdrawn IN (0,1)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK (action_key = CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global/' || id ELSE 'business/' || business_id || '/' || id END),
    CHECK (origin <> 'legacy' OR category = 'business-operational'),
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX action_logs_global_key ON action_logs(id) WHERE business_id IS NULL
CREATE INDEX action_logs_occurrence ON action_logs(occurred_at, action_key)
CREATE INDEX action_logs_occurred_date ON action_logs(occurred_date, action_key)

CREATE TABLE action_businesses (
    action_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES action_logs(action_key),
    business_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (action_key, business_id)
)
CREATE INDEX action_businesses_business ON action_businesses(business_id, action_key)

CREATE TABLE action_revisions (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    action_key TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES action_logs(action_key),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('add','edit','remove')),
    snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot_json) AND json_type(snapshot_json) = 'object'),
    recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    performed_by TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
    provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(provenance_json)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (action_key, revision),
    CHECK ((operation = 'add') = (revision = 1))
)
CREATE INDEX action_revisions_scope ON action_revisions(business_id, action_key, revision)

CREATE TRIGGER action_logs_identity_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON action_logs
WHEN NEW.business_id IS NOT OLD.business_id OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.action_key IS NOT OLD.action_key
    OR NEW.origin IS NOT OLD.origin OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.recorded_by IS NOT OLD.recorded_by
    OR NEW.performed_by IS NOT OLD.performed_by
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action identity, origin, attribution and recording time are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_logs_withdrawn_final BEFORE UPDATE ON action_logs
WHEN OLD.withdrawn = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A withdrawn Action keeps its history and accepts no later change'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_logs_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON action_logs
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Actions are not deleted'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_businesses_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON action_businesses
WHEN (SELECT category FROM action_logs WHERE action_key=NEW.action_key) IS NOT 'business-operational'
    OR (SELECT withdrawn FROM action_logs WHERE action_key=NEW.action_key) = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Only a current business-operational Action has business links'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_businesses_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON action_businesses
WHEN (SELECT withdrawn FROM action_logs WHERE action_key=OLD.action_key) = 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A withdrawn Action keeps its business links'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_revisions_current BEFORE INSERT ON action_revisions
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_logs WHERE action_key=NEW.action_key AND business_id IS NEW.business_id
    AND revision=NEW.revision)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An Action revision records the Action''s current revision in its owning scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_revisions_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON action_revisions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action revisions are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER action_revisions_keep BEFORE DELETE ON action_revisions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Action revisions are retained'); END

CREATE TRIGGER item_tags_action_scope BEFORE INSERT ON item_tags
WHEN NEW.item_type='action' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_logs WHERE business_id IS NEW.business_id AND id=NEW.item_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An Action tag belongs to an Action in the same owning scope'); END

CREATE TRIGGER thread_follows_action_scope BEFORE INSERT ON thread_follows
WHEN NEW.item_type='action' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM action_logs WHERE business_id IS NEW.business_id AND id=NEW.item_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An Action follow belongs to an Action in the same owning scope'); END

CREATE TABLE context_inputs (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(id) = 36),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    input_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (input_kind IN ('general','action')),
    item_id TEXT,
    revision INTEGER,
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('add','edit','remove')),
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'),
    submitted_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
        CHECK (state IN ('queued','processing','blocked','published','discard_requested','discarded')),
    context_event_id TEXT UNIQUE CHECK (context_event_id IS NULL OR (length(context_event_id) = 5 AND context_event_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*')),
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt >= 0),
    result_json TEXT CHECK (result_json IS NULL OR json_valid(result_json)),
    error_json TEXT CHECK (error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)),
    UNIQUE (item_id, revision),
    CHECK ((input_kind = 'action' AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND revision IS NOT NULL)
        OR (input_kind = 'general' AND item_id IS NULL AND revision IS NULL)),
    CHECK (state IN ('published','discarded') OR result_json IS NULL),
    CHECK (state != 'published' OR context_event_id IS NOT NULL),
    FOREIGN KEY (item_id, revision) REFERENCES action_revisions(action_key, revision)
)
CREATE INDEX context_inputs_by_state ON context_inputs(state, sequence)
CREATE INDEX context_inputs_by_scope ON context_inputs(business_id, sequence)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX context_inputs_single_open_head ON context_inputs((1))
    WHERE state IN ('processing','blocked','discard_requested')

CREATE TRIGGER context_inputs_action_revision
BEFORE INSERT ON context_inputs
WHEN NEW.input_kind = 'action' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM action_revisions r
    WHERE r.action_key = NEW.item_id AND r.revision = NEW.revision AND r.business_id IS NEW.business_id
      AND r.operation = NEW.operation AND r.recorded_by = NEW.submitted_by)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'An Action input must snapshot its stored revision in the same namespace');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_inputs_immutable_input
BEFORE UPDATE OF sequence, id, business_id, input_kind, item_id, revision, operation, payload_json, submitted_by, created_at
ON context_inputs
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context input is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_inputs_final
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_inputs
WHEN OLD.state IN ('published','discarded')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A published or discarded Context input is final');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_inputs_legal_transition
BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON context_inputs
WHEN NEW.state IS NOT OLD.state AND NOT (
       (OLD.state = 'queued' AND NEW.state IN ('processing','blocked','discarded'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'processing' AND NEW.state IN ('published','blocked'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'blocked' AND NEW.state IN ('processing','discard_requested'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'discard_requested' AND NEW.state IN ('discarded','published')))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Illegal Context input state transition');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_inputs_keep_history
BEFORE DELETE ON context_inputs
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context input history is retained');
END

CREATE TABLE context_input_controls (
    sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(id) = 36),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    input_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_inputs(id),
    intent TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (intent IN ('retry','discard')),
    expected_state TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (expected_state IN ('queued','processing','blocked','published','discard_requested','discarded')),
    requested_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','applied','rejected')),
    resolved_at TEXT,
    result_json TEXT CHECK (result_json IS NULL OR json_valid(result_json)),
    CHECK ((status = 'pending') = (resolved_at IS NULL))
)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX context_input_one_pending_control ON context_input_controls(input_id)
    WHERE status = 'pending'

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_controls_scope
BEFORE INSERT ON context_input_controls
WHEN NEW.business_id IS NOT (SELECT business_id FROM context_inputs WHERE id = NEW.input_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A control request belongs to its input''s namespace');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_controls_immutable_request
BEFORE UPDATE OF sequence, id, business_id, input_id, intent, expected_state, requested_by, requested_at
ON context_input_controls
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context control request is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_controls_resolve_once
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_input_controls
WHEN OLD.status != 'pending'
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A resolved Context control request is final');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_controls_keep_history
BEFORE DELETE ON context_input_controls
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context control history is retained');
END

CREATE TABLE context_input_attempts (
    input_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_inputs(id),
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt >= 1),
    context_event_id TEXT CHECK (context_event_id IS NULL OR (length(context_event_id) = 5 AND context_event_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*')),
    cause TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cause IN ('queue','retry')),
    control_id TEXT REFERENCES context_input_controls(id),
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT CHECK (outcome IN ('published','blocked')),
    finished_at TEXT,
    result_json TEXT CHECK (result_json IS NULL OR json_valid(result_json)),
    error_json TEXT CHECK (error_json IS NULL OR json_valid(error_json)),
    PRIMARY KEY (input_id, attempt),
    CHECK ((outcome IS NULL) = (finished_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((cause = 'retry') = (control_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (context_event_id IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(outcome, '') = 'blocked')
)

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_attempts_immutable_start
BEFORE UPDATE OF input_id, attempt, context_event_id, cause, control_id, started_at
ON context_input_attempts
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context attempt start is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_attempts_outcome_once
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_input_attempts
WHEN OLD.outcome IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A finished Context attempt is final');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_input_attempts_keep_history
BEFORE DELETE ON context_input_attempts
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context attempt history is retained');
END

CREATE TABLE context_source_bindings (
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('general','action')),
    source_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    bound_by_input TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_inputs(id),
    bound_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_kind, source_key)
)
CREATE INDEX context_source_bindings_by_scope ON context_source_bindings(business_id, source_kind, source_key)

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_bindings_admitting_input
BEFORE INSERT ON context_source_bindings
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_inputs i WHERE i.id = NEW.bound_by_input AND i.input_kind = NEW.source_kind
    AND i.business_id IS NEW.business_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Context source binding records its admitting input''s kind and namespace');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_bindings_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_source_bindings
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Context source binding is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_bindings_keep

    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context source bindings are retained');

CREATE TABLE context_source_versions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('document','instruction')),
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_id) = 36),
    source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_revision >= 1),
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('add','edit','remove')),
    source_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    source_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_digest) = 64 AND source_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    retracts_revision INTEGER CHECK (retracts_revision IS NULL OR retracts_revision >= 1),
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (source_kind, source_id, source_revision),
    CHECK ((operation = 'remove') = (retracts_revision IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (retracts_revision IS NULL OR retracts_revision < source_revision),
    CHECK (source_path = CASE source_kind WHEN 'document' THEN 'foundation/documents/' ELSE 'foundation/instructions/' END
                         || source_id || '.txt')
)
CREATE INDEX context_source_versions_by_scope ON context_source_versions(business_id, source_kind, source_id, source_revision)

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_versions_lineage
BEFORE INSERT ON context_source_versions
WHEN NEW.source_revision IS NOT COALESCE((SELECT MAX(v.source_revision) FROM context_source_versions v
        WHERE v.source_kind = NEW.source_kind AND v.source_id = NEW.source_id), 0) + 1
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_source_versions v WHERE v.source_kind = NEW.source_kind AND v.source_id = NEW.source_id
        AND v.business_id IS NOT NEW.business_id)
  OR NEW.operation IS NOT (CASE
        WHEN NEW.operation = 'remove' THEN 'remove'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_source_versions v WHERE v.source_kind = NEW.source_kind
                 AND v.source_id = NEW.source_id) THEN 'add'
        WHEN (SELECT v.operation FROM context_source_versions v WHERE v.source_kind = NEW.source_kind
                 AND v.source_id = NEW.source_id ORDER BY v.source_revision DESC LIMIT 1) = 'remove' THEN 'add'
        ELSE 'edit' END)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A source version continues its accepted lineage in the same scope');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_versions_retraction
BEFORE INSERT ON context_source_versions
WHEN NEW.operation = 'remove' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM context_source_versions v
    JOIN context_filings f ON f.source_version_id = v.id
    JOIN context_inputs i ON i.id = f.input_id
    WHERE v.source_kind = NEW.source_kind AND v.source_id = NEW.source_id AND v.source_revision = NEW.retracts_revision
      AND v.operation != 'remove' AND i.state = 'published')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A retraction names one exact published version of its source');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_versions_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_source_versions
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A source version is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_source_versions_keep
BEFORE DELETE ON context_source_versions
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Source versions are retained');
END

CREATE TABLE context_filings (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    source_version_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES context_source_versions(id),
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES jobs(id),
    program_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (program_id IN ('context.file','context.instruct')),
    program_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (program_version >= 1),
    definition_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(definition_digest) = 64),
    worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    initiated_by TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
    input_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES context_inputs(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX context_filings_by_scope ON context_filings(business_id, created_at)

CREATE TRIGGER context_filings_bound_job
BEFORE INSERT ON context_filings
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = NEW.job_id AND j.business_id IS NEW.business_id AND j.kind = NEW.program_id
        AND j.principal_id = NEW.worker_id AND j.initiated_by_principal_id IS NEW.initiated_by
        AND json_extract(j.arguments_json, '$.filing_id') = NEW.id AND j.state = 'queued')
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_source_versions v WHERE v.id = NEW.source_version_id AND v.business_id IS NEW.business_id
        AND ((v.source_kind = 'document' AND NEW.program_id = 'context.file')
          OR (v.source_kind = 'instruction' AND NEW.program_id = 'context.instruct' AND v.source_id = NEW.job_id)))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A filing binds its source version to its own prepared registered job');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_filings_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_filings
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A Context filing is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_filings_keep
BEFORE DELETE ON context_filings
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context filings are retained');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_filing_controlled_inputs
BEFORE INSERT ON context_inputs
WHEN NEW.input_kind = 'general' AND (json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.path') LIKE 'foundation/documents/%'
        OR json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.path') LIKE 'foundation/instructions/%')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_filings f JOIN context_source_versions v ON v.id = f.source_version_id
        WHERE f.input_id = NEW.id AND f.business_id IS NEW.business_id AND v.source_path = json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.path')
          AND v.operation = NEW.operation)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Controlled Context paths hold only the input of their own filing');
END

CREATE TABLE context_completions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 36),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    filing_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES context_filings(id),
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id),
    input_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES context_inputs(id),
    source_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_source_versions(id),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('published','discarded')),
    context_event_id TEXT,
    published_commit TEXT,
    reason_json TEXT CHECK (reason_json IS NULL OR json_valid(reason_json)),
    outcome_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(outcome_digest) = 64 AND outcome_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending','applied','conflict')),
    application_json TEXT CHECK (application_json IS NULL OR json_valid(application_json)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT,
    CHECK ((state = 'applied') = (resolved_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (state = 'pending' OR application_json IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (outcome != 'published' OR (context_event_id IS NOT NULL AND published_commit IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (outcome != 'discarded' OR (reason_json IS NOT NULL AND published_commit IS NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX context_completions_by_state ON context_completions(state, created_at)

CREATE TRIGGER context_completions_bound
BEFORE INSERT ON context_completions
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_filings f JOIN context_inputs i ON i.id = f.input_id
        WHERE f.id = NEW.filing_id AND f.job_id = NEW.job_id AND f.input_id = NEW.input_id
          AND f.source_version_id = NEW.source_version_id AND f.business_id IS NEW.business_id
          AND i.state = NEW.outcome AND i.context_event_id IS NEW.context_event_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A completion binds its filing, job, input and source version to the input''s terminal outcome');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_completions_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF id, business_id, filing_id, job_id, input_id, source_version_id, outcome, context_event_id, published_commit,
    reason_json, outcome_digest, created_at ON context_completions
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A completion''s outcome is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_completions_applied_final
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_completions
WHEN OLD.state = 'applied'
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'An applied completion is final');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_completions_keep
BEFORE DELETE ON context_completions
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Context completions are retained');
END
context-graph-edits

CREATE TABLE context_graph_edits (
    input_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(input_id) = 36) REFERENCES context_inputs(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    reserved_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
        CHECK (length(reserved_event_id) = 5 AND reserved_event_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'),
    plan_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(plan_digest) = 64 AND plan_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    expected_revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(expected_revision) IN (40, 64) AND expected_revision NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(plan_json) AND json_type(plan_json) = 'object'),
    attribution_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(attribution_json) AND json_type(attribution_json) = 'object'),
    targets_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(targets_json) AND json_type(targets_json) = 'array'),
    CHECK (json_extract(plan_json, '$.expected_revision') = expected_revision)
)

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_new_binding
BEFORE INSERT ON context_graph_edits
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_inputs i WHERE i.id = NEW.input_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_inputs i WHERE i.context_event_id = NEW.reserved_event_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_input_attempts a WHERE a.context_event_id = NEW.reserved_event_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A graph-edit binding is created before its own new input and with an event ID nothing used');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_delegation
BEFORE INSERT ON context_graph_edits
WHEN NOT COALESCE(json_type(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation') = 'null' OR (
        json_type(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation') = 'object'
    AND json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.principal_kind') = 'agent'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation')) = 3
    AND json_type(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.binding_id') = 'text'
    AND length(json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.binding_id')) = 36
    AND json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.binding_id') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'
    AND json_type(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.assignment_id') = 'text'
    AND length(json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.assignment_id')) = 36
    AND json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.assignment_id') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'
    AND json_type(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.generation') = 'integer'
    AND json_extract(NEW.attribution_json, '$.delegation.generation') >= 1), 0)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A graph-edit binding records a closed delegation: null, or exactly its binding, assignment and generation');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_graph_edits
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A graph-edit binding is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_keep
BEFORE DELETE ON context_graph_edits
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Graph-edit bindings are retained');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_controlled_inputs
BEFORE INSERT ON context_inputs
WHEN (substr(json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.path'), 1, 17) = 'foundation/edits/'
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits x WHERE x.input_id = NEW.id))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits g
    WHERE g.input_id = NEW.id AND NEW.input_kind = 'general' AND NEW.operation = 'add' AND NEW.state = 'queued'
      AND NEW.context_event_id IS NULL AND NEW.attempt = 0
      AND json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.path') = 'foundation/edits/' || g.reserved_event_id || '.txt'
      AND json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.submitted_by') = NEW.submitted_by
      AND json_extract(g.attribution_json, '$.principal_id') = NEW.submitted_by
      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(NEW.payload_json)) = 5
      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(NEW.payload_json, '$.metadata')) = 3
      AND json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.metadata.kind') = 'graph_edit'
      AND json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.metadata.title') = 'Explicit graph edit'
      AND json_extract(NEW.payload_json, '$.metadata.origin') = 'controlled_caller')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Controlled graph-edit paths hold only the input of their own graph-edit binding');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_input_event
BEFORE UPDATE OF context_event_id ON context_inputs
WHEN NEW.context_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (
     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits g WHERE g.reserved_event_id = NEW.context_event_id AND g.input_id != NEW.id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits g WHERE g.input_id = NEW.id AND g.reserved_event_id != NEW.context_event_id))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A graph edit uses exactly its reserved Context event ID, which no other input may use');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_graph_edits_attempt_event
BEFORE INSERT ON context_input_attempts
WHEN NEW.context_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (
     EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits g WHERE g.reserved_event_id = NEW.context_event_id AND g.input_id != NEW.input_id)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_graph_edits g WHERE g.input_id = NEW.input_id AND g.reserved_event_id != NEW.context_event_id))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A graph-edit attempt carries exactly its reserved Context event ID, which no other input may use');
END

CREATE TABLE context_usage_calls (
    call_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (call_id = attempt_id || ':' || stage),
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    input_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES context_inputs(id),
    context_event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(context_event_id) = 5 AND context_event_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'),
    attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(attempt_id) = 32 AND attempt_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    library_attempt_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(library_attempt_sequence) = 'integer' AND library_attempt_sequence >= 1),
    stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('bootstrap','propagation')),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('started','completed','failed')),
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(started_at) = 27 AND started_at GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]T[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]Z'),
    finished_at TEXT CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR (length(finished_at) = 27 AND finished_at GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]T[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]Z')),
    configured_model TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(configured_model) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    configured_effort TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(configured_effort) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    configured_service_tier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(configured_service_tier) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    observed_provider TEXT CHECK (observed_provider IS NULL OR length(observed_provider) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    observed_model TEXT CHECK (observed_model IS NULL OR length(observed_model) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    native_thread_id TEXT CHECK (native_thread_id IS NULL OR length(native_thread_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    native_turn_id TEXT CHECK (native_turn_id IS NULL OR length(native_turn_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    input_tokens INTEGER CHECK (input_tokens IS NULL OR (typeof(input_tokens) = 'integer' AND input_tokens >= 0)),
    cached_input_tokens INTEGER CHECK (cached_input_tokens IS NULL OR (typeof(cached_input_tokens) = 'integer' AND cached_input_tokens >= 0)),
    output_tokens INTEGER CHECK (output_tokens IS NULL OR (typeof(output_tokens) = 'integer' AND output_tokens >= 0)),
    reasoning_output_tokens INTEGER CHECK (reasoning_output_tokens IS NULL OR (typeof(reasoning_output_tokens) = 'integer' AND reasoning_output_tokens >= 0)),
    total_tokens INTEGER CHECK (total_tokens IS NULL OR (typeof(total_tokens) = 'integer' AND total_tokens >= 0)),
    cost_usd TEXT CHECK (cost_usd IS NULL OR (typeof(cost_usd) = 'text' AND length(cost_usd) BETWEEN 1 AND 40
        AND cost_usd GLOB '[0-9]*' AND cost_usd NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*')),
    usage_source TEXT CHECK (usage_source IS NULL OR length(usage_source) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    usage_scope TEXT CHECK (usage_scope IS NULL OR usage_scope IN ('native','call')),
    usage_updates INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(usage_updates) = 'integer' AND usage_updates >= 0),
    ignored_updates INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(ignored_updates) = 'integer' AND ignored_updates >= 0),
    bootstrap_call_id TEXT CHECK (bootstrap_call_id IS NULL OR (stage = 'propagation' AND bootstrap_call_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]:bootstrap')),
    error_type TEXT CHECK (error_type IS NULL OR length(error_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
    error_message TEXT CHECK (error_message IS NULL OR length(error_message) <= 300),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((state = 'started') = (finished_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((state = 'failed') = (error_type IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((error_type IS NULL) = (error_message IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((usage_updates > 0) = (usage_source IS NOT NULL) AND (usage_source IS NOT NULL) = (usage_scope IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (usage_scope IS NOT 'native' OR (native_thread_id IS NOT NULL AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_binding
BEFORE INSERT ON context_usage_calls
WHEN NEW.business_id IS NOT (SELECT business_id FROM context_inputs WHERE id = NEW.input_id)
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM context_input_attempts a
                   WHERE a.input_id = NEW.input_id AND a.context_event_id = NEW.context_event_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A usage call belongs to its queue input''s namespace and a Context event that input reserved');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_bootstrap_link
BEFORE INSERT ON context_usage_calls
WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM context_usage_calls other
    WHERE ((NEW.bootstrap_call_id IS NOT NULL AND other.call_id = NEW.bootstrap_call_id)
        OR (NEW.bootstrap_call_id IS NOT NULL AND other.bootstrap_call_id = NEW.bootstrap_call_id)
        OR (NEW.stage = 'bootstrap' AND other.bootstrap_call_id = NEW.call_id))
      AND (other.input_id <> NEW.input_id OR other.context_event_id <> NEW.context_event_id))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A bootstrap call and every call that references it belong to one input and Context event');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_immutable_identity
BEFORE UPDATE OF call_id, business_id, input_id, context_event_id, attempt_id, library_attempt_sequence, stage, started_at,
    configured_model, configured_effort, configured_service_tier, bootstrap_call_id, recorded_at
ON context_usage_calls
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A usage call identity is immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_final
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_usage_calls
WHEN OLD.state IN ('completed','failed')
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A completed or failed usage call is final');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_native_identity
BEFORE UPDATE OF native_thread_id, native_turn_id ON context_usage_calls
WHEN (OLD.native_thread_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.native_thread_id IS NOT OLD.native_thread_id)
  OR (OLD.native_turn_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.native_turn_id IS NOT OLD.native_turn_id)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A native thread or turn identity cannot be reassigned');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_no_rollback
BEFORE UPDATE ON context_usage_calls
WHEN NEW.usage_updates < OLD.usage_updates OR NEW.ignored_updates < OLD.ignored_updates
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A newer usage observation cannot be rolled back');
END

CREATE TRIGGER context_usage_calls_keep_history
BEFORE DELETE ON context_usage_calls

    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Usage call history is retained');
END

CREATE TABLE business_sandboxes (
    business_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES businesses(id),
    desired_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (desired_generation >= 1),
    desired_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running' CHECK (desired_state IN ('running', 'stopped')),
    observed_generation INTEGER CHECK (observed_generation >= 1),
    environment_id TEXT CHECK (environment_id IS NULL OR (
        length(environment_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 256
        AND environment_id NOT GLOB '*[^ -~]*'
    )),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'ready', 'stopped', 'failed')),
    error_code TEXT CHECK (error_code IS NULL OR error_code IN (
        'configuration_missing',
        'environment_conflict',
        'environment_unavailable',
        'environment_unhealthy',
        'provisioning_failed'
    )),
    lease_fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lease_fence >= 0),
    lease_until TEXT,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, disk_used_bytes INTEGER CHECK (disk_used_bytes IS NULL OR disk_used_bytes >= 0), disk_budget_bytes INTEGER CHECK (disk_budget_bytes IS NULL OR disk_budget_bytes >= 0), disk_reserved_bytes INTEGER CHECK (disk_reserved_bytes IS NULL OR disk_reserved_bytes >= 0), disk_available_bytes INTEGER CHECK (disk_available_bytes IS NULL OR disk_available_bytes >= 0), disk_host_floor_bytes INTEGER CHECK (disk_host_floor_bytes IS NULL OR disk_host_floor_bytes >= 0), disk_checked_at TEXT, disk_error_code TEXT CHECK (disk_error_code IS NULL OR disk_error_code IN ('environment_conflict', 'environment_unavailable')),
    CHECK ((observed_generation IS NULL) = (environment_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (observed_generation IS NULL OR observed_generation <= desired_generation),
    CHECK (state <> 'ready' OR (
        desired_state = 'running' AND observed_generation = desired_generation
        AND environment_id IS NOT NULL
        AND error_code IS NULL
    )),
    CHECK (state <> 'stopped' OR (
        desired_state = 'stopped' AND error_code IS NULL
    )),
    CHECK (
        (state = 'pending' AND (error_code IS NULL OR error_code = 'configuration_missing'))
        OR (state = 'failed' AND error_code IS NOT NULL)
        OR (state IN ('ready', 'stopped') AND error_code IS NULL)
    ),
    CHECK (lease_until IS NULL OR length(lease_until) BETWEEN 20 AND 40)
)

VALUES('relationships','update',inbox_actor(),json_object('business_id',OLD.business_id,'id',OLD.id,'from_type',OLD.from_type,'from_id',OLD.from_id,'to_type',OLD.to_type,'to_id',OLD.to_id,'role',OLD.role,'context',OLD.context,'created_by',OLD.created_by,'revision',OLD.revision),json_object('business_id',NEW.business_id,'id',NEW.id,'from_type',NEW.from_type,'from_id',NEW.from_id,'to_type',NEW.to_type,'to_id',NEW.to_id,'role',NEW.role,'context',NEW.context,'created_by',NEW.created_by,'revision',NEW.revision)); END

CREATE TABLE operational_assignments (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 parent_principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
 business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
 scope_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(scope_json)),
 objective TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(objective) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
 plan_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(plan_json)),
 plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(plan_revision >= 1),
 links_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(links_json)),
 allowed_operations_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(allowed_operations_json)),
 constraints_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(constraints_json)),
 internal_recipients_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(internal_recipients_json)),
 completion_evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(completion_evidence_json)),
 escalation_rules_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(escalation_rules_json)),
 resource_bounds_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(resource_bounds_json)),
 selected_model TEXT NOT NULL,
 reasoning_effort TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reasoning_effort IN ('low','medium','high','xhigh')),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','waiting','blocked','paused','completed','cancelled')),
 dispatch_reason TEXT,
 checkpoint_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(checkpoint_json)),
 next_step TEXT,
 wake_at TEXT,
 wake_condition_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(wake_condition_json)),
 result_json TEXT CHECK(result_json IS NULL OR json_valid(result_json)),
 execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(execution_generation >= 0),
 lease_id TEXT,
 lease_until TEXT,
 attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count >= 0),
 max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 20),
 runtime_thread_id TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1), execution_started_at TEXT, runtime_used_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK(runtime_used_seconds >= 0), retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    CHECK(retry_count >= 0),
 CHECK((state='running' AND lease_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)
       OR (state<>'running' AND lease_id IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX operational_assignments_parent ON operational_assignments(parent_principal_id,state,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX operational_assignments_due ON operational_assignments(state,wake_at,lease_until)

CREATE TABLE operational_assignment_events (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operational_assignments(id),
 sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence >= 1),
 execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(execution_generation >= 0),
 actor_principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload_json)),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(assignment_id,sequence)
)
CREATE INDEX operational_assignment_events_history ON operational_assignment_events(assignment_id,sequence)

CREATE TABLE operational_delegation_bindings (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operational_assignments(id),
 parent_principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
 execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(execution_generation >= 1),
 credential_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 registration_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES machine_registrations(id),
 runtime_thread_id TEXT,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revoked_at TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
 UNIQUE(assignment_id,execution_generation)
)
CREATE INDEX operational_delegation_bindings_assignment ON operational_delegation_bindings(assignment_id,revoked_at)

CREATE TABLE operational_action_receipts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operational_assignments(id),
 action_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
 execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(execution_generation >= 1),
 operation_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash)=64),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('started','uncertain','applied')),
 effect_ref_json TEXT CHECK(effect_ref_json IS NULL OR json_valid(effect_ref_json)),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1), parent_principal_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id), delegation_binding_id TEXT REFERENCES operational_delegation_bindings(id), plan_revision INTEGER CHECK(plan_revision IS NULL OR plan_revision >= 1),
 UNIQUE(assignment_id,action_key)
)
CREATE INDEX operational_action_receipts_state ON operational_action_receipts(assignment_id,state)

CREATE TABLE operational_event_claims (
 event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES inbox_events(id),
 assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operational_assignments(id),
 execution_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(execution_generation >= 1),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('claimed','handled','released')),
 lease_until TEXT,
 outcome TEXT,
 handled_at TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
 CHECK((state='claimed' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND handled_at IS NULL)
       OR (state='handled' AND lease_until IS NULL AND handled_at IS NOT NULL)
       OR (state='released' AND lease_until IS NULL AND handled_at IS NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX operational_event_claims_assignment ON operational_event_claims(assignment_id,state,event_id)

CREATE TABLE browser_handles (

)
CREATE INDEX browser_handles_turn ON browser_handles(turn_id)

CREATE TABLE "learning_candidates" (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    candidate_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(candidate_json)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    work_state TEXT CHECK(work_state IN ('in-progress', 'implemented', 'rejected-in-work')),
    agent_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    work_targets_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    work_outcome_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    filing_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_candidates_workspace ON learning_candidates(scope_key, id)

CREATE TABLE "learning_decisions" (
    business_id TEXT,
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    feedback TEXT,
    changes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(changes_json)),
    decided_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_decisions_workspace ON learning_decisions(scope_key, candidate_id)

CREATE TABLE "learning_runs" (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(result_json)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_runs_workspace ON learning_runs(scope_key, id)

CREATE TABLE "learning_scan_state" (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    transcript_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(state_json)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, session_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_scan_state_workspace ON learning_scan_state(scope_key, session_id)

CREATE TABLE "learning_history" (
    business_id TEXT,
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event TEXT NOT NULL,
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    after_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_history_workspace ON learning_history(scope_key, id)
CREATE INDEX learning_history_candidate ON learning_history(business_id, candidate_id, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE learning_issues (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(issue_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    engine_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(engine_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    engine_scope_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(engine_scope_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    policy_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tracking'
        CHECK (policy_state IN ('tracking', 'open', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'ignored', 'snoozed')),
    hold_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (hold_state IN ('none', 'held', 'resolved')),
    engine_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bound' CHECK (engine_status IN ('bound', 'unbound', 'superseded')),
    current_candidate_id TEXT,
    revisit_json TEXT CHECK (revisit_json IS NULL OR json_valid(revisit_json)),
    release_json TEXT CHECK (release_json IS NULL OR json_valid(release_json)),
    -- Null unless the hold lists more predecessor issues (the engine's lineage and the host's re-enrollment relations together)
    -- than one revisit can name: then the explicit incomplete-reconciliation marker with the total count. Such a hold is never
    -- released by naming the predecessors it links.
    hold_json TEXT CHECK (hold_json IS NULL OR json_valid(hold_json)),
    stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stale IN (0, 1)),
    issue_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (issue_revision >= 1),
    material_evidence_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (material_evidence_revision >= 1),
    evidence_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
    support_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(support_json)),
    eligibility_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(eligibility_json)),
    projected_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, issue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, current_candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issues_workspace ON learning_issues(scope_key, issue_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issues_engine_identity ON learning_issues(engine_id, issue_id)
CREATE INDEX learning_issues_policy ON learning_issues(scope_key, policy_state, hold_state)

CREATE TABLE learning_issue_candidates (
    business_id TEXT,
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 1),
    predecessor_candidate_id TEXT,
    package_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (package_revision >= 1),
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, candidate_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, issue_id) REFERENCES learning_issues(scope_key, issue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, predecessor_candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issue_candidates_workspace ON learning_issue_candidates(scope_key, candidate_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issue_candidates_ordinal ON learning_issue_candidates(scope_key, issue_id, ordinal)

CREATE TABLE learning_issue_actions (
    business_id TEXT,
    id TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (issue_revision >= 1),
    candidate_id TEXT,
    candidate_revision INTEGER,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('deliver', 'successor', 'append_evidence', 'resurface', 'evidence_update',
        'hold', 'stale', 'supersede', 'accept', 'reject', 'reopen', 'ignore', 'snooze', 'revisit', 'note',
        'work_start', 'work_defer', 'work_done', 'work_drop', 'work_note')),
    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    actor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_kind IN ('human', 'agent', 'system')),
    idempotency_key TEXT,
    policy_revision_before INTEGER,
    policy_revision_after INTEGER,
    before_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(before_json)),
    after_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(after_json)),
    baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(baseline_json)),
    reasoning TEXT,
    reasoning_source TEXT CHECK (reasoning_source IS NULL OR reasoning_source IN
        ('owner_conversation_via_agent', 'owner_direct', 'agent_work_explanation')),
    owner_instruction TEXT,
    agent_rationale TEXT,
    revisit_condition_json TEXT CHECK (revisit_condition_json IS NULL OR json_valid(revisit_condition_json)),
    operational_reason TEXT,
    corrects_action_id TEXT,
    details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(details_json)),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, issue_id) REFERENCES learning_issues(scope_key, issue_id),
    CHECK ((reasoning IS NULL) = (reasoning_source IS NULL))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issue_actions_workspace ON learning_issue_actions(scope_key, id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issue_actions_replay ON learning_issue_actions(scope_key, issue_id, actor_id, idempotency_key)
    WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX learning_issue_actions_issue ON learning_issue_actions(scope_key, issue_id, created_at, id)

CREATE TRIGGER learning_issue_actions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_issue_actions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning issue actions are append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER learning_issue_actions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON learning_issue_actions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning issue actions are append-only'); END

CREATE TABLE learning_issue_links (
    business_id TEXT,
    link_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    predecessor_issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('split', 'merge', 'source_reenrollment_overlap',
        'source_reenrollment_incomplete_lineage')),
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, link_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, issue_id) REFERENCES learning_issues(scope_key, issue_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_issue_links_workspace ON learning_issue_links(scope_key, link_id)
CREATE INDEX learning_issue_links_issue ON learning_issue_links(scope_key, issue_id)
CREATE INDEX learning_issue_links_predecessor ON learning_issue_links(scope_key, predecessor_issue_id)

CREATE TRIGGER learning_issue_links_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_issue_links
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning issue links are append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER learning_issue_links_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON learning_issue_links
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning issue links are append-only'); END

CREATE TABLE learning_engine_packages (
    business_id TEXT,
    engine_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    issue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (package_revision >= 1),
    ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 1),
    package_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(package_hash) = 64),
    material_evidence_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (material_evidence_revision >= 1),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('created', 'successor', 'appended')),
    candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    package_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(package_json)),
    received_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, engine_id, issue_id, package_revision, ordinal),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, issue_id) REFERENCES learning_issues(scope_key, issue_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (scope_key, candidate_id) REFERENCES learning_candidates(scope_key, id)
)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_engine_packages_workspace
    ON learning_engine_packages(scope_key, engine_id, issue_id, package_revision, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX learning_engine_packages_candidate ON learning_engine_packages(scope_key, candidate_id, package_revision)

CREATE TRIGGER learning_engine_packages_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON learning_engine_packages
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning engine package receipts are append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER learning_engine_packages_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON learning_engine_packages
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'learning engine package receipts are append-only'); END

CREATE TABLE learning_engine_enrollments (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    engine_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(engine_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
    -- Engine source identity is agent:<agent_id>:<epoch>. A disabled engine source cannot be revived, so each
    -- re-activation starts a new epoch (and therefore a new engine source); older epochs stay disabled.
    epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (epoch >= 1),
    enrolled_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, agent_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_engine_enrollments_workspace ON learning_engine_enrollments(scope_key, agent_id)

CREATE TABLE learning_engine_state (
    business_id TEXT REFERENCES businesses(id),
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    engine_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (epoch >= 1),
    transcript_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(transcript_hash) = 64),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('processed', 'retry', 'needs_attention', 'deferred')),
    lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (lifecycle IN ('complete', 'incomplete', 'unknown')),
    coverage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (coverage IN ('complete', 'partial', 'unknown')),
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    detail_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(detail_json)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN business_id IS NULL THEN 'global' ELSE 'business:' || business_id END) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (business_id, session_id),
    CHECK ((status = 'deferred') = (attempts = 0)),
    CHECK (status = 'deferred' OR lifecycle = 'complete'),
    CHECK (status != 'deferred' OR lifecycle != 'complete'),
    CHECK (status != 'deferred' OR coverage = 'unknown')
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_engine_state_workspace ON learning_engine_state(scope_key, session_id)

CREATE INDEX system_incident_observations_fingerprint ON system_incident_observations(fingerprint,observed_at)

CREATE TABLE system_incident_recoveries (
 incident_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES system_incidents(id),
 observation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES system_incident_observations(id),

CREATE TABLE telegram_state (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 'telegram'),

    owner_principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id),

    last_poll_at TEXT,
    last_update_received_at TEXT,

    outage_json TEXT CHECK(outage_json IS NULL OR json_valid(outage_json)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_state_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_state
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.bot_id IS NOT OLD.bot_id OR NEW.installation_id IS NOT OLD.installation_id
  OR NEW.activation_at IS NOT OLD.activation_at
  OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR NEW.poll_offset < OLD.poll_offset
  OR NEW.config_generation < OLD.config_generation OR NEW.binding_effective_at < OLD.binding_effective_at
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Telegram bot and installation identity, activation cutoff, binding cutoff and poll cursor never move backwards');
END

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_state_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON telegram_state
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Telegram integration state keeps its cursor and cutoff');
END

CREATE TABLE telegram_updates (
    bot_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(bot_id > 0),
    update_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(update_id >= 0),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('message','message_reaction','ignored')),
    chat_id INTEGER,
    message_id INTEGER,
    actor_id INTEGER,
    sent_at TEXT,
    normalized_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(normalized_json)),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' CHECK(state IN ('received','done','ignored','failed')),
    reason TEXT,
    result_json TEXT CHECK(result_json IS NULL OR json_valid(result_json)),
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts >= 0),
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    processed_at TEXT,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (bot_id, update_id),
    CHECK(state NOT IN ('done','ignored') OR processed_at IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT
CREATE INDEX telegram_updates_pending ON telegram_updates(bot_id, state, update_id)
CREATE INDEX telegram_updates_message ON telegram_updates(chat_id, message_id)

CREATE TRIGGER telegram_updates_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON telegram_updates
WHEN NEW.bot_id IS NOT OLD.bot_id OR NEW.update_id IS NOT OLD.update_id OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind
  OR (NEW.normalized_json IS NOT OLD.normalized_json AND NOT (OLD.state = 'received' AND NEW.state = 'ignored'))
  OR NEW.received_at IS NOT OLD.received_at
  OR (OLD.state IN ('done','ignored') AND NEW.state IS NOT OLD.state)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'A stored Telegram update keeps its normalized content (an ignored one loses only its text) and a finished update stays finished');
END

CREATE TABLE telegram_messages (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('inbound','outbound')),
    chat_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(chat_name IN ('ordubashy','signoffs','urgent')),
    chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    telegram_message_id INTEGER CHECK(telegram_message_id IS NULL OR telegram_message_id > 0),
    agent_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('reply','blocking_input','update','owner','notice','signoff_post','signoff_reply','urgent')),
    body TEXT,
    body_redacted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(body_redacted IN (0,1)),
    sensitive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(sensitive IN (0,1)),
    reply_to_id TEXT REFERENCES telegram_messages(id),
    reply_to_telegram_id INTEGER,
    request_key TEXT CHECK(request_key IS NULL OR length(request_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    input_mode TEXT CHECK(input_mode IS NULL OR input_mode IN ('text','secret','screen_action')),
    request_reason TEXT,
    request_state TEXT CHECK(request_state IS NULL OR request_state IN ('pending','answered','expired','cancelled')),
    request_expires_at TEXT,
    request_closed_at TEXT,
    update_id INTEGER,
    outbox_id TEXT,
    occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, message_thread_id INTEGER CHECK(message_thread_id IS NULL OR message_thread_id > 1),
    CHECK(body_redacted = 1 OR body IS NOT NULL OR direction = 'outbound'),
    CHECK(sensitive = 0 OR body_redacted = 1),
    CHECK(sensitive = 0 OR body IS NULL),
    CHECK((request_key IS NULL) = (input_mode IS NULL) AND (request_key IS NULL) = (request_state IS NULL)),
    CHECK(purpose = 'blocking_input' OR request_key IS NULL),
    CHECK(request_state IS NULL OR request_state = 'pending' OR request_closed_at IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX telegram_messages_provider ON telegram_messages(chat_id, telegram_message_id)
